name: Choirs
overview: Scripture portrays choirs as a vital expression of worship and praise to God, exemplified by organized groups giving thanks and making joyful noise, as seen in Nehemiah's appointment of singing companies on the city walls. The celestial imagery in Job highlights the heavenly chorus rejoicing before God, while the Psalms repeatedly call all the earth to sing praises and offer joyful noise to the Lord. These passages emphasize that singing in congregation is a God-ordained means of expressing reverence, thanksgiving, and communal joy among His people.
